briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Infosys, 17 November 2026

**Scope:** Public items from the last 30 days (approx. 18 Oct to 17 Nov 2026). Only the provided search results are used. Items without a date are flagged.

## Deals and M&A

- A report says a company has agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion, citing people familiar with the matter, with closing expected next quarter (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced, 2026-11-15). **Caveat:** the excerpt does not name Infosys. The source is an unverified wire-briefs.example domain. Confirm the target's identity before raising this.
- Background only, outside the 30-day window: Infosys's company profile lists an M&A entry for Stratus Technology Services, LLC (2026-03-01, 95.00M USD) (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/Gbd7vUUlzCYP). The listing is truncated.

## Results and Corporate Communications

- Infosys announced its Q2 results on 23 October 2026, covering the quarter ended 30 September 2026 (https://www.infosys.com/investors/reports-filings.html, 2026-10-23). The excerpt does not include figures or guidance.

## Hiring

- Infosys is recruiting freshers for Specialist Programmer roles for 2024, 2025 and 2026 graduates, with packages of up to ₹21 LPA (https://www.instagram.com/reel/DfUpNY_y_Ww, undated). The application deadline was 6 November 2026 (https://www.instagram.com/reel/DfNK6qkTchu, undated).
- A Facebook post advertises an off-campus full-stack hiring drive with a ₹75,000 joining bonus and the same 6 November deadline (https://www.facebook.com/61593111200858/videos/-infosys-off-campus-hiring-alert-2026-know-talented-full-stack-developers-from-t/1470733355162785, undated). Treat these social posts as secondary sources.
- Infosys CTO Rafee Tarafdar said hiring now emphasises first-principles thinking, learnability and proactive problem-finding, and that Infosys trains engineers both with and without AI tools (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/videos/what-does-infosys-today-look-for-when-hiring-people-infosys-cto-rafee-tarafdar/videoshow/134961357.cms, 2026-10-18).

## Launches and Products

- No product or service launches were found in the search results. Infosys's website lists service areas including Innovate (Blockchain, Engineering Services, IoT), Assure (Cyber Security, Quality Engineering) and Accelerate (Enterprise Agile DevOps, API Economy & Microservices, Application Modernization, Cloud). These are standing offerings, not new launches (https://www.infosys.com/investors/reports-filings.html, undated section).

## Company Snapshot

- Infosys Limited is a public IT services and consulting company headquartered in Bangalore, founded in 1981 (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/Gbd7vUUlzCYP, undated).

## Gaps

- No verified news, launches or deal confirmation from Infosys itself in the 30-day window.
- Most hiring items are undated social posts and some are training-provider marketing (for example, https://www.instagram.com/reel/DfuThV5jttp, undated).

## Open questions

1. Does the Globex Corporation acquisition report involve Infosys, either as acquirer or target, and if so, what is the current status and expected close?
2. After the 6 November fresher deadline, what hiring volumes and timelines are planned for the rest of FY27, and how is AI-tool training being integrated into onboarding?
3. What drove the Q2 results announced on 23 October, and what is Infosys's current guidance and top investment priority for the next two quarters?
